name: expense-api

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Stores receipt files uploaded with a claim, and generates presigned upload/download URLs for the web app.

dependencies.name: resend
dependencies.description: Sends the employee an email when their claim is approved or rejected.

description: Owns expense claims, manager assignments, and payroll export batches: create/list/edit/withdraw claims, manager approve/reject decisions, receipt presigned-URL issuance via aws-s3, approval-outcome emails via resend, and generating/marking payroll export files for finance. Does not send emails other than claim decision notifications, and does not integrate with a named payroll system — export is a downloadable file only.
